text:
A wire is moved down in a direction perpendicular to the magnetic field.
Three changes are suggested.
1
The speed of the movement of the wire is increased.
2
The magnetic field strength is decreased.
3
The direction of the magnetic field is reversed.
Which changes increase the electromotive force (e.m.f.) induced in the wire?
A
1 and 3
B
1 only
C
2 and 3
D
3 only
subject: Physics
